subject: Function-identifier
notes: kb/Work/PB757.md landed w46i2. A spelled OMITTED crosses as the null carrier and a trailing omission (14.8.2.1, every trailing formal OPTIONAL) leaves the slot absent, which the callee's program-ABI adapters answer as omitted; the condition is true in the function (golden: F(OMITTED W4)=OP, F(W4 OMITTED)=PO, F(W4)=PO, F(W4 W4)=PP). Trailing omission of a non-OPTIONAL formal stays COBOL1506 (test).
